engine.description: Database engine. Only `postgres` is supported today (Keycloak needs Postgres). Kept as an enum so a future backend can add engines without widening the type.

version.description: Engine major version (e.g. "15"). Backend-agnostic string; the RDS Composition maps it to engineVersion. Optional — omit to take the backend default.

size.description: Abstract t-shirt size. The backend Composition maps it to concrete units. RDS mapping (ai/testing-guidelines §1 — small instance classes only, single-AZ, minimal storage): small → db.t4g.micro, medium → db.t4g.small.

storageGB.description: Allocated storage in GB. Defaults to 20 (the account's minimal-storage constraint, ai/testing-guidelines §1).

databaseName.description: Name of the initial database created inside the instance (Keycloak uses `keycloak`). Lower-case alphanumeric; becomes RDS dbName.

region.description: AWS region for the RDS backend. Defaults to us-east-1; account-region comes from a binding/EnvironmentConfig at provisioning time, never hardcoded downstream (AGENTS §8.1).

endpoint.description: Database connection host (RDS instance address) once available. Feeds the consuming chart's externalDatabase.host.

port.description: Database connection port (5432 for postgres). Feeds the consuming chart's externalDatabase.port.

secretRef.description: Reference to the Kubernetes connection Secret the platform materializes in the XR's namespace. The consuming chart points externalDatabase.existingSecret at this name. Keys: username, password (plus endpoint / port / attribute.* the provider writes).

ready.description: True once the backing database instance is available and the connection Secret has been written. Mirrors the XR Ready condition for quick boolean consumption.
